music.title: Salto de partida
music.prompt: Original premium arcade platform-adventure instrumental. 40 seconds, 120 BPM, 4/4, bright D major. Exuberant forward motion, playful heroic confidence and a clear memorable melody. Main palette: expressive plucked synth lead, rounded articulate synth bass, crisp acoustic-electronic drums, short mallet answers and light staccato string accents. Tasteful 8-bit pulse-wave flourishes punctuate phrase endings; modern full-frequency production with clean transients, controlled highs, punch and depth. Introduce this compact proposed Feka motif: D4 F-sharp4 A4 E4 D4, with eighth, eighth, quarter, eighth, dotted-quarter rhythm; notation is guidance. Develop it with a distinct answering phrase and a short playful harmonic detour, then bring it back clearly. At 0-4 seconds establish the groove immediately, 4-16 present the hook, 16-28 vary and answer it, 28-36 deliver a satisfying reprise, 36-40 return toward the opening harmony with an edit-friendly tail. Musical comedy through precise rests and unexpected small accents. Leave space for gameplay cues; keep decorative high notes sparse. Tight low end, focused center, lively but mono-compatible stereo image. Instrumental only: no singing, speech, choir or whistling. Entirely original melody and arrangement; do not imitate an existing game soundtrack, artist or franchise. No acoustic-folk ensemble, national or regional musical styling, lo-fi degradation, trailer risers or fruit sounds. A polished listening proposal; seamless looping will be edited and verified separately.

music.title: Impulso pixel
music.prompt: Original premium arcade platform-adventure instrumental, a more kinetic alternative for the same charming comic hero. 40 seconds, 144 BPM, 4/4, bright D major with playful passing chords. A catchy expressive pulse-wave lead trades phrases with sparkling FM keys, agile rounded synth bass, a tight punchy drum-kit groove, short brass-synth stabs and a restrained arpeggiated countermelody. Use selective 8-bit timbres inside a detailed modern mix, never constant high-register beeping or imitation hardware distortion. Proposed Feka motif: D4 F-sharp4 A4 E4 D4, eighth, eighth, quarter, eighth, dotted-quarter rhythm; use it as melodic guidance and give it a confident answer. At 0-3 seconds start with an immediate playable groove, 3-16 establish the hook, 16-27 contrast with a lighter response, 27-37 return with extra rhythmic energy, 37-40 turn back toward the opening harmony with a clean edit-friendly tail. Bounce and humor come from syncopation and precise stops, while the melody stays easy to remember. Preserve headroom and leave space for jump, impact and warning sounds. Defined bass, crisp non-harsh highs, stable mono-compatible center and carefully placed stereo details. Instrumental only: no vocals, speech, choir or whistling. Original composition with no quotation or imitation of any existing game melody, artist or franchise. No folk or geographic musical identity, acoustic regional ensemble, cinematic trailer climax or fruit sounds. A fully produced listening proposal; a seamless loop is a later editing and listening task.
